friendly_name: Layer merge, pack registration and effective reads
purpose_context: Core needs the service to answer what is in force for a project. After the activation register, the remaining steps of ADR-0055 are the cross-level layer merge on the depends_on resolver, whole-pack registration with full replacement, and the four effective reads (#103) that today answer 501. This mission builds them so a service-v0.x release candidate can follow.
purpose_tldr: The charter service merges built-in, org and project packs, replaces a registered pack whole, and answers what is in force for an activation.
